title: Emotional Support Evaluation Framework via Controllable and Diverse Seeker Simulator

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the behavioral, semantic, and lexical diversity of simulated help-seekers compared to real-world datasets to identify language models' inherent tendency toward overly cooperative, verbose, and "easy" interaction styles.

Using VADER sentiment analysis to compute the mean and variance of emotional polarity in generated utterances, revealing a strong bias toward uniformly positive expressions and limited emotional variability in baseline simulators.
